# 查询单个仓位 (USER\_DATA)

- **GET** `/capi/v3/account/position/singlePosition`

权重(IP): 2

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 是 | 交易对 |

**请求示例**

```
curl "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/account/position/singlePosition?symbol=BTCUSDT" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

**返回参数**

同 [查询全部仓位](/api-doc/zh-CN/contract/Account_API/GetAllPositions)。
